info.title: AgentHU API
info.description:
Backend, data platform and Agent foundations for the AgentHU Personal AI.

All external sources are normalized into a unified **Event** contract before any
domain logic runs. The Backend is the single source of truth for identity,
permissions, events, tasks, goals, current state, memory, plans and files.

This is the **M0** API surface: engineering baseline plus frozen core contracts.

post.description: OAuth2 password grant form, used by the OpenAPI 'Authorize' button.

Batch ingestion contract used by the desktop client sync coordinator.

``accepted_event_ids`` / ``duplicate_event_ids`` contain the client
``client_event_id`` values so the client can clear its pending queue.

X-Next-Cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor (D-029) for the next page; absent when this is the last page. Present only on the keyset path (no offset parameter).

get.description: Recompute and return the projection of the user's present.

post.description: Confirm a memory (also the documented "un-reject" path).
Replace a memory with a corrected version (201: a new row is created).
Reject a memory; the live row stays as a REJECTED subject_key placeholder.

get.description:
Return the client's "today" plan.

The confirmed plan is returned when present; otherwise a deterministic
baseline plan is generated (pending confirmation) so the client always has
something to display and confirm. Selection and per-user/day idempotency
live in ``planner.resolve_today_plan`` (DECISIONS.md D-019).
Extracted chunks of one file (D-033), always user-scoped.

get.description: Current consent state plus the exact text the client must render.

delete.description:
§3.5 deletion entry: citations are snapshot tuples on the row, so
deleting an answer never resurrections a deleted file's content.

post.description:
Create a session. ``client_request_id`` is accepted (frozen B1
request shape) but carries no idempotency here — message-level
``client_message_id`` is the dedup key (ruling A2).

delete.description:
Archive the session and soft-delete its live messages in ONE
transaction (A3): retrieval eligibility (reads, search, agent history
faces) drops atomically with the user-visible deletion. Idempotent-204
like the grant revoke; rows remain for audit lineage — the runs and
pending actions that cite these messages keep resolving.

post.description:
Create the user message + a QUEUED chat run in one transaction.

Idempotency (ruling A2): ``(session_id, client_message_id)`` is unique,
and the run's ``client_request_id`` derives server-side as
``chat:{session_id}:{client_message_id}`` — a lost-202 resend returns
the SAME run/message pair (latest attempt under that operation key).
Execution happens in the worker; the assistant message lands when the
run reaches a terminal state.

delete.description:
Soft-delete one message; reads and search exclude it from this
transaction on (no separate FTS index to invalidate — eligibility is a
WHERE clause over ``deleted_at``). Idempotent-204.

get.description:
In-session substring search over message content (A3).

Matching is a case-insensitive literal substring filter
(``%needle%`` with autoescaped wildcards). The pg_trgm GIN index
accelerates it for needles of 3+ characters; shorter needles form no
trigram and degrade to an unindexed filter that still returns correct
results (D-034's 过滤降级). Results are newest-first with the same
``(created_at, id)`` keyset as the session listing, so pagination stays
stable across edits; deleted messages never match.
Current consent state plus the exact text the client must render.

AgentRunToolCallRead.title: AgentRunToolCallRead
AgentRunToolCallRead.description:
Audit skeleton of one tool call (review-point-6 condition: the
user-visible audit face must be able to join the run's tool sequence).

ChatMessageSend.title: ChatMessageSend
ChatMessageSend.description:
Frozen send request (B1 Zod mirror): ``client_message_id`` is
REQUIRED — message-level idempotency (ruling A2) rides on it.

ChatMessageSendResponse.title: ChatMessageSendResponse
ChatMessageSendResponse.description:
202 body (B1 Zod mirror): poll the run or the session for the
assistant reply.

ChatSessionCreate.title: ChatSessionCreate
ChatSessionCreate.description:
Frozen create request (B1 Zod mirror). The title is optional; an
empty title is backfilled deterministically from the first user message
(truncation, no LLM).

CurrentStateUpdate.title: CurrentStateUpdate
CurrentStateUpdate.description: User-controlled overrides applied before the next projection.

DecisionLocator.title: DecisionLocator
DecisionLocator.description: Position-only locator: identifies a source, never copies its body.

DocumentEvidence.title: DocumentEvidence
DocumentEvidence.description: A citation pinned to an exact document version (M3 grounding tuple).

EventEvidence.title: EventEvidence
EventEvidence.description: A citation of a stored Event by id.

MaterialCitationRead.title: MaterialCitationRead
MaterialCitationRead.description:
Snapshot tuple (D-031 evidence shape, B-facing per §6 freeze).

``checksum`` pins the file version that was read; spans are offsets into
the chunk's normalized text (same coordinate system as verification).

MemoryCorrectRequest.title: MemoryCorrectRequest
MemoryCorrectRequest.description:
User correction payload for POST /memory/{id}/correct.

Content is the corrected text; confidence optionally overrides (the old
row's value carries over when absent). The new version is CONFIRMED by
definition — the user wrote it.

MemoryEvidence.title: MemoryEvidence
MemoryEvidence.description: A citation of another memory row (e.g. L2 facts citing their L1 base).

PendingActionMutation.title: PendingActionMutation
PendingActionMutation.description:
Frozen mutation request (B1 Zod mirror): optimistic version echo plus
the client-generated id whose settled response is cached so a lost-HTTP
resend returns the same body instead of a second dispatch.

PlanGenerateRequest.title: PlanGenerateRequest
PlanGenerateRequest.description: Deterministic baseline planner input (no LLM in M0).
